status: candidate frozen references; derived and cross-checked by the author, not yet independently refuted
theory: small-displacement linear elasticity; straight runs along global X; Euler-Bernoulli flexure, or Timoshenko with A_s = kappa_E A_nominal where the document selects it; thick-wall (Lame) annulus under internal pressure

conventions.global_axes: X along the run, Z up; gravity along -Z
conventions.support_reaction: global force (moment) of the support on the pipe at its node; + along the positive global axis; a held support's row is its replacement restraint's reaction, under the support's own identity (open reading 1)
conventions.nodal_translation: global translation from the authored geometry
conventions.pressure_stress: Lame hoop and radial stress on the named section basis, tension positive
conventions.pressure_elongation: 'independent': the row is the same with the case's pressure elongation off or on (README, 'Pressure elongation')
conventions.exact: an element of Q(pi): a rational, q*pi, q/pi or a ratio of polynomials in pi

rho_c_section.meaning: the section's own contents density (ordinary cases)

rho_c_test.meaning: contents density of the condition the test case selects

nu.meaning: Poisson's ratio (exact route); G = E/(2(1 + nu))

p_ordinary.meaning: authored pressure of the ordinary cases

p_test.meaning: authored pressure of the hydrostatic test cases

a.meaning: span length of the two- and four-span models

L1.meaning: span length of the single-span model

kv_2s.meaning: two-span model: middle variable spring rate

Fc_2s.meaning: two-span model: middle variable spring cold load

k_4s_b.meaning: four-span model: spring rate at B

Fce_4s_c.meaning: four-span model: constant-effort force at C

kv_4s_d.meaning: four-span model: variable spring rate at D

Fc_4s_d.meaning: four-span model: variable spring cold load at D

w_double_counted.label: negative control: g (metal + section contents + test contents + insulation)

binary64_input_check.method: each input replaced by Fraction(float(input)), one at a time and then all together; every case re-solved exactly by the flexibility and stiffness methods; the sign (+, 0, -) of every reaction, displacement, stress and weight compared with the nominal solve

refusals.scenario: DOC-2S-SPRING authored without the pressure contract (pressure-free route), its case HT-2S-SPRING-HELD keeping its test condition
refusals.expected: the test case is refused by name; it is not solved as an ordinary case and publishes no result

refusals.scenario: DOC-2S-SPRING with a second support at node:b, a constant-effort support on uz, beside the spring on uz; case HT-2S-SPRING-HELD
refusals.expected: both are held, giving two rigid restraints on one degree of freedom whose split of the reaction is not determined by mechanics; the case is refused by name with no partial result

refusals.scenario: DOC-2S-SPRING with a rigid vertical support (uz) at node:b beside the spring on uz; case HT-2S-SPRING-HELD
refusals.expected: the replacement duplicates an existing rigid restraint, so its reaction under the spring's identity is not determined; the case is refused by name with no partial result
